abstract: BACKGROUND: Laparoscopic removal of ovarian dermoid cysts has been associated with increased risk for recurrence. OBJECTIVES: To investigate the risk factors associated with recurrence of dermoid cysts. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective review of all women who underwent cystectomy for ovarian dermoid cysts by laparoscopy or laparotomy. At discharge, patients were instructed to undergo a yearly ultrasound exam. A follow-up telephone call was conducted to assess whether an additional surgery for dermoid cysts was required and whether ultrasound recurrence of dermoid cysts was suspected. RESULTS: The study cohort included 102 participants (92 [90.2%] operated by laparoscopy and 10 [9.8%] by laparotomy). The mean follow-up from the index surgery to the interview was 72.1 ± 38.2 months. The rates of recurrent surgery were similar among women who underwent laparoscopic cystectomy compared with laparotomy (5/92 [5.4%] vs. 1/10 [10.0%], respectively; P = 0.5), while the rates of reported ultrasound recurrence were significantly lower in the laparoscopy group compared with the laparotomy group (10/102 [10.9%] vs. 4/10 [40.0%], respectively; P = 0.03). Additional factors including age, cyst diameter, diagnosis of torsion, intraoperative cyst spillage, estimated blood loss, intraperitoneal adhesions, and postoperative fever were not associated with recurrence. CONCLUSIONS: Ultrasound recurrence of dermoid cysts is not uncommon and could be associated with the surgical approach.
abstract_ja: 背景: 腹腔鏡下での卵巣類皮嚢腫摘除術は、再発リスクの増加と関連している。目的: 類皮嚢腫の再発に関連するリスク因子を検討すること。方法: 腹腔鏡下または開腹下で卵巣類皮嚢腫に対する嚢腫摘出術を受けた全女性を対象に後方視的検討を行った。退院時、患者には毎年の超音波検査を受けるよう指示した。フォローアップの電話調査を実施し、類皮嚢腫に対する追加手術が必要であったか、また類皮嚢腫の超音波上の再発が疑われたかを確認した。結果: 対象コホートは102例(腹腔鏡手術92例[90.2%]、開腹手術10例[9.8%])であった。初回手術から面接までの平均フォローアップ期間は72.1±38.2か月であった。再手術率は腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術と開腹術で同様であった(5/92[5.4%]対1/10[10.0%]、P=0.5)。一方、超音波上の再発率は開腹群と比較して腹腔鏡群で有意に低かった(10/102[10.9%]対4/10[40.0%]、P=0.03)。年齢、嚢腫径、捻転の診断、術中の嚢腫破綻、推定出血量、腹腔内癒着、術後発熱などのその他の因子は再発と関連しなかった。結論: 類皮嚢腫の超音波上の再発は稀ではなく、手術法と関連している可能性がある。
